    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 66,
            "text": "- &#96;src/atlas_client/services/pulse_meter.py&#96; contains &#96;main()&#96; but is started by the API via &#96;pulse_manager&#96; (not intended to be run directly)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "## The big picture runtime flow (from wake to spoken answer)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "### 1) Wake service detects phrase → calls the API"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72,
            "text": "File: &#96;src/wake_service/main.py&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74,
            "text": "- Uses &#96;sounddevice.RawInputStream&#96; to capture mic PCM16 audio at 16kHz."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75,
            "text": "- Uses Vosk &#96;KaldiRecognizer&#96; with a **very small grammar** (wake + sleep phrases + &#96;[unk]&#96;)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76,
            "text": "- On partial and final recognition hits, POSTs JSON:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77,
            "text": "  - POST &#96;WAKE_ENDPOINT&#96; (defaults to API &#96;/wake&#96;) with &#96;{\"intent\":\"wake\"}&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78,
            "text": "  - POST &#96;SLEEP_ENDPOINT&#96; (defaults to API &#96;/sleep&#96;) with &#96;{\"intent\":\"sleep\"}&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79,
            "text": "- Uses cooldown + “N partial hits” gating to reduce false triggers."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81,
            "text": "### 2) Flask API receives &#96;/wake&#96; → starts an assistant session (background thread)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83,
            "text": "File: &#96;src/atlas_client/app/api.py&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85,
            "text": "Key endpoints:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87,
            "text": "- &#96;GET /&#96;: serves &#96;src/atlas_client/ui/static/index.html&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88,
            "text": "- &#96;GET /health&#96;: returns &#96;{ok, session_active, session_state, pulse_running}&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89,
            "text": "- &#96;GET /ui&#96;: returns the current UI state dict (&#96;atlas_client.ui.ui_state&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90,
            "text": "- &#96;GET /image-search&#96;: calls SerpAPI Google Images and returns URL list"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91,
            "text": "- &#96;GET /image-proxy&#96;: proxies image bytes for the UI (to avoid CORS/hotlink issues)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92,
            "text": "- &#96;POST /wake&#96;: starts session if not already active:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93,
            "text": "  - starts the **pulse meter subprocess**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94,
            "text": "  - spawns a thread that runs &#96;core.main.run_session()&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95,
            "text": "- &#96;POST /sleep&#96;: signals the session to stop and stops pulse"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96,
            "text": "- &#96;POST /shutdown&#96;: stops pulse, signals stop, then terminates the API process via &#96;os.kill(os.getpid(), SIGTERM)&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98,
            "text": "Concurrency note:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100,
            "text": "- &#96;_session_active&#96; + &#96;_session_lock&#96; prevent multiple concurrent sessions. If &#96;/wake&#96; is called while active, it simply ensures pulse is running and returns &#96;already_active&#96;."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102,
            "text": "### 3) &#96;run_session()&#96; creates an asyncio loop and runs &#96;session_main()&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104,
            "text": "File: &#96;src/atlas_client/core/main.py&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106,
            "text": "- Creates a new asyncio event loop in the background thread"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107,

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 446,
            "text": "- The orchestrator stores candidates in &#96;_pending_memory_candidates&#96; to help disambiguate the next user turn."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 447
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 448,
            "text": "### &#96;music&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 449
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 450,
            "text": "- Tool wrapper: &#96;src/atlas_client/tools/music.py&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 451,
            "text": "- Playback: &#96;src/atlas_client/audio/music_player.py&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 452,
            "text": "  - Searches YouTube via Data API v3"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 453,
            "text": "  - Extracts audio stream with &#96;yt_dlp&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 454,
            "text": "  - Plays with &#96;python-vlc&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 455,
            "text": "- Integration detail:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 456,
            "text": "  - If a “play” action happens during a turn, orchestrator schedules playback **after TTS** completes."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 457
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 458,
            "text": "### &#96;session_sleep&#96; / &#96;session_shutdown&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 459
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 460,
            "text": "- &#96;session_sleep&#96;: calls &#96;request_stop()&#96; (ends session but keeps API alive)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 461,
            "text": "- &#96;session_shutdown&#96;: POSTs &#96;/shutdown&#96; (kills API process; UI also triggers this on close)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 462
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 463,
            "text": "## Pulse meter (why it exists and how it works)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 464
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 465,
            "text": "The UI’s visual “energy” meter is decoupled from the assistant logic:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 466
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 467,
            "text": "1. API ensures pulse meter is running when session starts: &#96;app/pulse_manager.ensure_pulse_running()&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 468,
            "text": "2. Pulse meter (&#96;services/pulse_meter.py&#96;) listens on UDP (&#96;PULSE_UDP_HOST:PULSE_UDP_PORT&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 469,
            "text": "3. Azure TTS (&#96;audio/azure_tts_player.py&#96;) sends synthetic audio-like PCM chunks over UDP while speaking (and sends silence afterward to decay to idle)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 470,
            "text": "4. UI polls &#96;http://127.0.0.1:5056/pulse&#96; and maps &#96;level ∈ [0,1]&#96; to orb brightness/geometry"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 471
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 472,
            "text": "Important implication:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 473
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 474,
            "text": "- The visualization primarily reflects **TTS speaking activity**, not raw microphone input."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 475
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 476,
            "text": "## Debugging guide (map symptoms → components)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 477
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 478,
            "text": "### “UI says offline / nothing loads”"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 479
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 480,
            "text": "- Check: API process window/logs (&#96;logs/api.*.log&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 481,
            "text": "- Endpoint: &#96;GET http://127.0.0.1:5055/health&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 482,
            "text": "- Likely components: &#96;app/run_api.py&#96;, &#96;app/api.py&#96;, firewall/port issues"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 483
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 484,
            "text": "### “Wake phrase does nothing”"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 485
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 486,
            "text": "- Check: wake service logs (&#96;logs/wake.*.log&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 487,
            "text": "- Verify: it can reach &#96;GET /health&#96; and POST &#96;/wake&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 488,
            "text": "- Likely components: &#96;wake_service/main.py&#96;, mic device index (&#96;MIC_DEVICE_INDEX&#96;), Vosk model path (&#96;VOSK_MODEL_PATH&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 489
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 490,
            "text": "### “Session starts but no responses”"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 491
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 492,
            "text": "- Check: API &#96;/health&#96; shows &#96;session_state=running&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 493,
            "text": "- Check: &#96;OPENAI_API_KEY&#96; is set and valid"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 494,
            "text": "- Likely components: &#96;core/orchestrator.py&#96; websocket connection, &#96;audio_in.sender&#96; sending audio, OpenAI service connectivity"
          }
        ],
        "range": {

          },

          }

            "text": "def main():"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93,
            "text": "    LOG.info(\"Wake service starting...\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 94,
            "text": "    LOG.info(\"Wake phrases : \" + \", \".join(WAKE_PHRASES))"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95,
            "text": "    LOG.info(\"Sleep phrases: \" + \", \".join(SLEEP_PHRASES))"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97,
            "text": "    # Wait for API to be ready at startup"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98,
            "text": "    if not wait_for_api():"
          },
          {

            "text": "        LOG.error(\"Failed to connect to API. Exiting.\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100,
            "text": "        return"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102,
            "text": "    last_trigger = 0.0"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 103,
            "text": "    consec_wake = 0"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104,
            "text": "    consec_sleep = 0"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105,
            "text": "    iteration_count = 0"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106,
            "text": "    api_down_count = 0"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107,
            "text": "    API_CHECK_INTERVAL = 50  # Check API health every 50 iterations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108,
            "text": "    MAX_API_DOWN_COUNT = 10  # Allow some failures before warning"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110,
            "text": "    with sd.RawInputStream("
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111,
            "text": "        samplerate=SAMPLE_RATE, blocksize=BLOCKSIZE,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112,
            "text": "        dtype='int16', channels=1, device=MIC_DEVICE,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113,
            "text": "        callback=callback"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114,
            "text": "    ):"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115,
            "text": "        LOG.info(\"Wake service running...\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116,
            "text": "        while True:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117,
            "text": "            # Check API health periodically (not on every iteration to reduce overhead)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118,
            "text": "            iteration_count += 1"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119,
            "text": "            if iteration_count % API_CHECK_INTERVAL == 0:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120,
            "text": "                if not api_alive():"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121,
            "text": "                    api_down_count += 1"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122,
            "text": "                    if api_down_count \u003e= MAX_API_DOWN_COUNT:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123,
            "text": "                        LOG.warning(f\"API appears to be down (checked {api_down_count} times). Continuing to listen...\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124,
            "text": "                else:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125,
            "text": "                    if api_down_count \u003e 0:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126,
            "text": "                        LOG.info(\"API is back online\")"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127,
            "text": "                    api_down_count = 0"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 129,
            "text": "            data = q.get()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130,
            "text": "            is_final = rec.AcceptWaveform(data)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 131,
            "text": "            now = time.time()"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 132,
            "text": "            cooldown_ok = (now - last_trigger) \u003e COOLDOWN_SEC"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 134,
            "text": "            if is_final:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 135,
            "text": "                try:"
          }
        ],
        "range": {

          },

          }

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 148,
            "text": "- &#96;core/orchestrator_response_done_tools.py&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 149,
            "text": "- &#96;core/orchestrator_finalize_utils.py&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 151,
            "text": "Important events:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 153,
            "text": "- **VAD turn start**: &#96;input_audio_buffer.committed&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154,
            "text": "  - increments a global &#96;turn_id&#96; in &#96;core/session_state.py&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 155,
            "text": "  - clears assistant text in UI (&#96;ui_state.clear_assistant()&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 156,
            "text": "  - records latency timestamps (&#96;vad_committed&#96;, &#96;vad_speech_stopped&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157,
            "text": "- **Transcription**: &#96;conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.completed&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 158,
            "text": "  - sets &#96;ui_state.user = transcript&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159,
            "text": "  - triggers exactly one &#96;response.create&#96; per turn via &#96;safe_create_response()&#96; (with “response already in flight” queuing)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 160,
            "text": "- **Streaming response**: &#96;response.output_text.delta&#96; / &#96;response.text.delta&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 161,
            "text": "  - appends deltas into &#96;rt[\"assistant_buf\"]&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162,
            "text": "  - writes to &#96;ui_state.assistant&#96; continually for live UI updates"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 163,
            "text": "- **Response completion**: &#96;response.done&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164,
            "text": "  - the core decision point: tool parsing + tool execution + final speaking"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 166,
            "text": "## “Tool-first” architecture (how decisions are made)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168,
            "text": "ATLAS uses a strict policy: **if the model needs a tool, it must output JSON only**."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170,
            "text": "### Tool call format"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172,
            "text": "The only supported tool call is a JSON object:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174,
            "text": "- &#96;{\"type\":\"tool\",\"name\":\"\u003ctool_name\u003e\",\"args\":{...}}&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 176,
            "text": "Direct answers can optionally be:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 178,
            "text": "- &#96;{\"type\":\"answer\",\"text\":\"...\"}&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180,
            "text": "Tool calls are parsed by:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182,
            "text": "- &#96;src/atlas_client/core/tool_call_parser.py&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 184,
            "text": "Tool registry and execution live in:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186,
            "text": "- &#96;src/atlas_client/router/tools_registry.json&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 187,
            "text": "- &#96;src/atlas_client/router/tool_executor.py&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189,
            "text": "### Turn policy at &#96;response.done&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191,
            "text": "File: &#96;src/atlas_client/core/orchestrator_event_handlers.py&#96; (&#96;handle_response_done&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193,
            "text": "1. Parse &#96;assistant_buf&#96; via &#96;parse_tool_calls()&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 194,
            "text": "2. If tool calls exist:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195,
            "text": "   - execute all tools via &#96;process_tool_calls_in_response_done()&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196,
            "text": "   - if a “two-pass” tool ran (web_search or memory_search), **re-inject results** into the conversation and request a follow-up response from the model"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197,
            "text": "   - otherwise, generate a short local “confirmation” string to speak (the model’s pre-tool text is never spoken)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198,
            "text": "3. Finalize:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 199,
            "text": "   - apply visual board markers (if present)"
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 199
          },
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 147
          }
        },

Here’s what was added:

### Flow
1. **Atlas** (floating button or transport rail) opens the overlay.
2. **First screen**: choose **Text** or **Voice** (keyboard vs microphone).
3. After you pick, the main panel opens with a **Text | Voice** toggle in the header so you can switch anytime.

### Text
- Same as before: transcript + input + **Send** (still uses `POST /api/chat`, which forces Atlas **text** mode and `/text`).

### Voice
- Calls **`POST /api/atlas/input-mode`** with `{ "mode": "voice" }` so Atlas uses the **realtime + mic** path (same as the Atlas desktop flow).
- The UI **polls** **`GET /api/atlas/ui`** ~every 480ms and shows **You** / **Atlas** from `user` and `assistant`.
- Structured payloads (images / visual boards) are merged with **`syncAtlasVoiceUi`** so **Search and visuals** updates without growing the text chat history.
- Footer reminds you to switch to **Text** to type.

### Backend
- **`ensure_atlas_session_mode("text" | "voice")`** in `atlas_http.py` — `/wake` and `/mode` both use the chosen mode (replacing hard-coded `"text"` everywhere).
- **`fetch_atlas_ui()`** — reads Atlas `/ui`.
- New router **`backend/product_shell/routers/atlas.py`**:
  - `POST /api/atlas/input-mode`
  - `GET /api/atlas/ui` → `{ ui, structured_outputs }`
- Router registered in **`main.py`**.

### Frontend
- **`postAtlasInputMode`**, **`fetchAtlasUi`** in `api/client.ts`.
- **`syncAtlasVoiceUi`** on the Zustand store.
- **`AtlasOverlay.tsx`** + **`atlasOverlay.css`** for the picker, segments, and voice layout.

**Note:** Voice mode uses the **machine’s default microphone** and Atlas on **5055**, not the browser mic API. Atlas must be running (`run_web_app.ps1` with Atlas enabled).
